provenance.description: Synthetic reference supplement for a cash equity. Multiplier, currency and settlement are fixture assumptions chosen to match the exporter's stated marketValue convention (quantity * closingMark * contractMultiplier); they are not asserted market conventions.

Synthetic EUR-denominated cash equity. Present so the FX branch is exercised: this engine holds no FX source, so a position whose currency is not the reporting currency must be refused rather than valued at an assumed parity.
